content: Prisilla le Aquila
Hiteng zawkciang in Paul sia Athens pan pai a, Corinth theng hi;

Taciang Aquila a kici Judah mi khat taw ki mu hi, ama sia Pontus ah a suak hi a, a zi Prisilla taw Italy pan a thet zawk uh ngei ngawl lai hi; banghangziam cile Claudius in Judah mi theampo Rome pan pusuak tu in thupia hi: taciang Paul sia amate kungah hongpai hi.
Amate taw khutthiam kibang ahi uhkom in amate kungah taam a, naseam khawm uh hi: banghangziam cile amate sia puanbuk khui te a hi uh hi.
Sabbath ni sim in synagogue sungah Judah mite le Greek mite thu sonpui in kaizawn tawntung uh hi.
Macedonia pan Silas le Timothy te a thet ciang in, Jesus sia Christ hi, ci thu Paul in Judah mite tungah hanciam in tettipang hi.

Amate in Paul langpan uh a, a sonsiat uh ciang in, Paul in a puan thin a, na thisan uh noma lutung ah om tahen; kei ka hile na thisan uh pan ka thiang hi: tu pan kipan in Gentile te kungah ka pai tu hi, ci hi.
Taciang Paul sia tua mun pan pai a, Justus innsung ah tum hi, ama in Pathian bia a, a inn sia synagogue taw kinai na a hihi.
Synagogue makai lianbel Crispus le a innkuanpui theampo in Topa um uh hi; taciang Corinth mi tampi te in zong za in um uh a, tui kiphum uh hi.
Tuazawkciang in Topa in mangmuna taw zan ciang inb Paul paupui a,

content.text: Lauheak in a, thuhil in, om thong heak in:
Banghangziam cile keima in kong ompui hi, kuama in hong vawtsia ngawl tu hi: banghangziam cile hi khuapui sungah keima in mi tampi ka nei hi,

content: ci hi.
Taciang Paul sia tua mun ah kumkhat le tha luk sung om suak a, amate sungah Pathian thuhil hi.
Gallio sia Rome ngam uk a sep lai in, Judah mite in thu kisitak in Paul langpan uh a, thukhenna tokhum mai ah paipui uh a,
Hisia pa in thukham paltan in Pathian bia tu in ngual kaizawn hi, ci uh hi.
Paul pau tu a kipat ciang in, Gallio in Judah mite kungah, hi thu sia a man ngawl le thusia hile, Maw, no Judah mite, note tungah thinsausak tu kisam ci in ngaisun khi hi:
Ahihang hi thu sia na thukham uh sung a thu le min te ki nialna ahile, noma in khensat tawm vun; banghangziam cile kei sia tabang thu te tungah thukhen ngawl tu khi hi, ci hi.
Taciang amate thukhen zum pan in hawlkhia siat hi.
Tuazawkciang in Greek mite in synagogue makai lianbel Sosthenes man uh a, thukhen na mai ah sat uh hi. Taciang Gallio in hi thu te awlmawk ngawl hi.

Taciang in Paul sia Corinth khua ah tawlkhat sung a om zawkciang in, suapui te nusia a, Pricilla le Aquila te taw Syria ah tembaw taw pai hi; taciang Cenchrea ah a sam met hi: banghangziam cile kamciam na a nei hang a hihi.
Ephesus khua theng uh a, tua mun ah Pricilla le Aquila te nusia hi: ahihang ama vateak synagogue sungah tum in, Judah mite taw thu kikum khawm uh hi.
Amate in ngei zaw hiat om tu a nget uh ciang, thukim pui ngawl hi;

Ahihang kikhenna kam te nusiat a, Jerusalem ah hi poai sia bangbangpo ahizong ka kihel kul hamtang hi; ahihang Pathian deina a om ahile, note kungah heakkik tu khi hi, ci hi. Taciang Ephesus pan in tembaw taw pai hi.
Caesarea a thet ciang in, pawlpi te paupui a, Antioch sangah pai hi.
Tua mun ah tawlkhat sung hun a zak zawkciang in pusuak kik a, nungzui te theampo hanthawn tu in Galatia le Phrygia ngamsung theampo ah pai hi.
Apollos
Taciang Alexandria khua ah a suak Judah mi Apollos a kici khat Ephesus ah hong theng hi, ama sia kamthiam mama a, laithiangtho taw kisai zong thahat mama hi.
Hisia pa sia Topa lampi taw kisai phatak a kihil mi a hihi; taciang thaalam ah thalawp mama a, Topa thu te thupitak in a son le a hil pa a hihi, ahihang John i tuiphumna thu bek he hi.
Taciang synagogue sungah hangsantak in thuhil kipan a: Aquila le Pricilla te in a zak uh ciang in, amate kungah sam hi, taciang Pathian lampi a kimtak in hilcian hi.

Apollos sia Achaia ngamkhen ah pai nuam ahikom, Ephesus khua a om suapui te in Achaia a om nungzui te kungah lai thak uh a, Apollos a san natu uh in hanthawn uh hi, a thet ciang in thu um mite sia hesuakna tungtawn in nasiatak in hu hi:
Banghangziam cile Jesus sia Christ hi, ci thu laithiangtho zang in a kilangtak in lak a, Judah mite nasiatak in zo hi.
